units.source_text: 我在服用安眠藥時的胡言亂語，竟然奇妙地變成了現實。

en.t: The nonsense I had babbled while taking sleeping pills somehow, strangely, became reality.

units.source_text: 這棟病房裡，清一色是男性的精神病患者，連看護者也是男性，沒有一個女人。

en.t: In that ward, all the mental patients were men, even the attendants were men, and there was not a single woman.

units.source_text: 我現在已不再是罪人，而是瘋子。

en.t: I was no longer a criminal now, but a madman.

units.source_text: 不，我絕對沒瘋，一刻也沒瘋過。

en.t: No, I was absolutely not mad; not for a single moment had I ever been mad.

units.source_text: 據說，大部分的瘋子都會這麼說自己。

en.t: It is said, however, that most madmen say that about themselves.

units.source_text: 換言之，被關進這所醫院的人是瘋子，沒被關進來的則是正常人。

en.t: In other words, those shut up in this hospital were madmen, while those not shut up here were normal people.

units.source_text: 我質問神靈：不抵抗也是一種罪過嗎？

en.t: I questioned God: is nonresistance also a sin?

units.source_text: 面對堀木那不可思議的美麗微笑，我淚流滿面，忘了判斷和抵抗，就坐上車，被帶到這裡，變成了一名瘋子。

en.t: Faced with Horiki's strangely beautiful smile, I burst into tears, forgot both judgment and resistance, got into the car, was brought here, and became a madman.
